authority_rule: Delayed canonical_open_blog_tabs is authoritative for dependent closure.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not ignore authority, guess values, or restart unaffected work.

event_contract.before_state: Chrome contains the source browsing session, but the complete set of currently open blog tabs and canonical page titles has not yet been returned.
event_contract.after_state: The tab worker returns exactly two canonical blog URL/title pairs; both and only those pages must be printed as readable title-named PDFs.
